title: Co-option of retrotransposons promotes antibody diversification
title_zh: 反转录转座子被劫持可促进抗体多样化
abstract: Activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID) accomplishes somatic hypermutation (SHM) of VH(D)JH genes in germinal center B cells for antibody diversification and affinity maturation. How AID specifically targets VH(D)JH remains unclear. We report the discovery of LINE-1 (L1) retrotransposons upstream to many VH genes in the immunoglobulin locus. These L1s are evolutionarily old, truncated, and retrotransposition dead. Recombined VH promoters generate long, strong antisense RNAs encoding upstream L1s, triggering the human silencing hub (HUSH) complex and AID recruitment, which we term L1-driven SHM. We show that L1-driven SHM occurs in vivo using HUSH conditional knockout mice and engineered mice with VH genes devoid of upstream L1s. Insertion of transcriptionally active L1s at non-immunoglobulin loci endogenously lacking upstream L1s promotes off-target SHM. We demonstrate that old retrotransposons serve physiological roles, and our findings reveal how B cells co-opted an anti-retrotransposon silencing mechanism to promote antibody diversity. In doing so, we established a new link between cell-intrinsic innate and adaptive immunity.
abstract_zh: 活化诱导胞苷脱氨酶（AID）在生发中心B细胞中催化VH(D)JH基因的体细胞高变（SHM），从而实现抗体多样化和亲和力成熟。AID如何特异性作用于VH(D)JH始终不清楚。我们报道了在免疫球蛋白基因座中，多数VH基因上游存在LINE-1（L1）反转录转座子。该类L1古老、截短并且失去转座能力。重组后的VH启动子产生长且强的反义RNA，编码上游L1，触发人类沉默枢纽（HUSH）复合体并招募AID，我们将其称为L1驱动的SHM。我们在体内利用HUSH条件性敲除小鼠以及缺失上游L1的工程小鼠，证明L1驱动的SHM确实发生。将转录活跃的L1插入到内源性缺乏上游L1的非免疫球蛋白位点会促进非靶向SHM。我们展示了古老反转录转座子可以发挥生理功能，并表明B细胞将抗转座子沉默机制重构利用于抗体多样化。由此我们建立了细胞内在先天免疫与适应性免疫之间新的联系。
